card.name: Contains / does not contain preservative
card.fires_on: The verb contain, containing or carries after a product name, mostly in preservative statements such as 'does not contain preservatives'. It also fires on a few mid-name pieces of drug names like quinuprestin/dalfopristin and FABHALTA.

modes.label: Contain verbs
modes.description: Contains, contain or containing right after a product name, in statements about preservatives or ingredients.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Middle piece of a brand or drug name such as FABHALTA or dalfopristin.
